svg.text: The Bill’s own path, not the applicant’s
Is ar scáth a chéile a mhaireann na daoine
Sources: Houses of the Oireachtas, Stages of a Bill; General Scheme, Irish Nationality and Citizenship (Amendment) Bill 2026
The General Scheme is not law.
It is a policy proposal. The Bill may change during scrutiny, and the numbers that matter most —
income threshold, welfare and housing lists, language and civics standards, waiver categories —
are set by regulation after enactment, not in the Act.
